newsitem.title: USA: U.S. to sell $26 bln of 3-, 6-mo bills March 3.
newsitem.headline: U.S. to sell $26 bln of 3-, 6-mo bills March 3.

text.p: The Treasury Department said on Tuesday it will auction $26 billion of three- and six-month bills on March 3 to pay down $200 million as $26.202 billion of bills are maturing.
The weekly bill sale will be equally divided between the two maturities. The bills will be issued on March 6. The three-month bills mature on June 5 and the six-month bills mature on September 4.
The CUSIP number for the three-month bills is 9127944L5 and for the six-month bills is 9127945L4.
